name: @opencode-ai/volt-vscode
description: Syntax highlighting and language intelligence for PLC languages (currently Structured Text / IEC 61131-3; more vendors and languages to come).

volt.structuredText.lspServer.description: Override the path to the volt-lsp-st bin. When empty (default), the extension auto-discovers it via Node module resolution from the workspace.

volt.structuredText.vendor.description: Which vendor's ST dialect this project targets. `auto` scans the workspace for vendor signals (.TcPOU, Tc-prefix pragmas → twincat; .project, OSCAT → codesys). Affects hover/completion filtering and the wrong-vendor-pragma diagnostic.

volt.structuredText.hover.showSource.description: Append the CODESYS documentation source URL to hover content.

volt.structuredText.completion.snippetSu.description: Use snippet expansions for completion items (e.g., pragmas with placeholder values).

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.reserved.description: Flag identifiers that collide with CODESYS reserved keywords.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.doubleUn.description: Flag identifiers starting with __ (reserved for system-generated names).

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.consecut.description: Flag identifiers containing multiple consecutive underscores.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.duplicat.description: Flag two declarations with the same name in the same scope.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.unresolv.description: Warn on identifiers in bodies that don't resolve in any reachable scope. Can false-positive on library-imported symbols.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.unknownP.description: Warn on pragma names not in either vendor's catalog.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.wrongVen.description: Warn when a pragma is known but belongs to the OTHER vendor (e.g. {attribute 'TcRpcEnable'} in a CODESYS project). Includes equivalent suggestion when available.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.pragmaMi.description: Error when a pragma is missing its required companion (e.g., instance-path requires reflection).

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.pragmaCo.description: Warn on mutually-exclusive pragmas applied to the same target.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.shadowin.description: Inform when a declaration shadows a same-name symbol in an outer scope.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.initSlot.description: Warn when {attribute 'global_init_slot' := 'N'} collides with a CODESYS-reserved slot.

volt.structuredText.diagnostics.conversi.description: Warn when a type-conversion function (e.g. INT_TO_DINT) is called with an argument whose declared type doesn't match the function's expected source type. Includes a suggested replacement (e.g. STRING_TO_DINT).
